pr_title: Fix script editor unexpected scroll upon resize
pr_body:
<!--
Pull requests should always be made for the `master` branch first, as that's
where development happens and the source of all future stable release branches.

Relevant fixes are cherry-picked for stable branches as needed.

Do not create a pull request for stable branches unless the change is already
available in the `master` branch and it cannot be easily cherry-picked.
Alternatively, if the change is only relevant for that branch (e.g. rendering
fixes for the 3.2 branch).
-->
Fixes #55691

PS: The root cause of this bug seems to be the discrepancy in `get_visible_line_count_in_range`, where it considers `p_to_line` either inclusive or exclusive depending on whether wrapping is enabled etc. This seems to cause confusion about what the callers of the function should expect for it to return. It might be a good idea to make it consistent, though it's out of the scope of this PR.

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/e8082003f19ad8d98b6b2f74f64f4eaa7fe86353/scene/gui/text_edit.cpp#L4286-L4304
pr_comments: Ok I changed `get_visible_line_count_in_range` to consider `p_to_line` inclusive in both cases. It does seem to fix mouse clicking for that case.

Would it make sense to remove these lines from `get_scroll_pos_for_line`:
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/e8082003f19ad8d98b6b2f74f64f4eaa7fe86353/scene/gui/text_edit.cpp#L4225-L4227
as the rest of the function will have the same behavior anyway?

> Would it make sense to remove these lines from get_scroll_pos_for_line, as the rest of the function will have the same behavior anyway?

No, it's a short out for performance.

issue_context.title: Script editor scrolls by itself when resizing any other stuff
issue_context.body:
### Godot version

ca2b0f6e776ed3e8898093caa9706c8e176fe406

### System information

Linux binogure 5.15.0-2-amd64 #1 SMP Debian 5.15.5-1 (2021-11-26) x86_64 GNU/Linux

### Issue description

![bug-auto-scroll](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/6616005/145040908-525e828e-4e50-4691-bdef-1e9e52f18c0a.gif)


### Steps to reproduce

- Launch Godot Engine
- Create a new script
- Type a very long script (can be anything)
- Resize any part of the editor

### Minimal reproduction project

_No response_

review_comments:
Should now be able to do:
```suggestion
	double new_line_scroll_pos = get_visible_line_count_in_range(0, CLAMP(p_line, 0, text.size() - 1)) - 1;
```

I think this doesn't work because `p_line`th line might be wrapped, increasing the return value by more than 1 
So it would have to be:
```cpp
	double new_line_scroll_pos = get_visible_line_count_in_range(0, CLAMP(p_line, 0, text.size() - 1)) - 1 - get_line_wrap_count(CLAMP(p_line, 0, text.size() - 1));
```
Even then, there might be hiding/folding involved, so maybe a second call to `get_visible_line_count_in_range` might be needed.

On the other hand, if `get_visible_line_count_in_range` is changed to become "inclusive-from" "exclusive-to" (and fixing other places where it's used), this line could become:
```cpp
	double new_line_scroll_pos = get_visible_line_count_in_range(0, CLAMP(p_line, 0, text.size()));
```
which would work even when `p_line == 0`

Ahh I see, good spot. 

Probably for the best to keep as is, otherwise we'd have to fix too many other places.
